# Managed overlapping feature

Existing feature: PAY-123 — Saved payment methods for customer checkout.
Requested feature: PAY-456 — Store a corporate payment method for invoice settlement.

Expected controls:
- classify as overlap or related dependency, not an exact duplicate;
- show shared capability and distinct actors/scope;
- stop for a product-owner decision to merge, split, supersede, or set boundaries;
- do not silently create overlapping requirements.
